    • GameState

      public GameState(int gameId, int targetPlayers, List<OfferTile> offerTrack, TurnOrderTile turnOrderTile, Deck<Card> tribeDeck, Map<Integer, Deck<BuildingCard>> buildingDecks)
      The game state is initialized with the provided parameters.
      Parameters:
      gameId - the identifier of the game
      targetPlayers - the expected number of players
      offerTrack - the list of offer tiles
      turnOrderTile - the turn order tile
      tribeDeck - the deck of tribe cards
      buildingDecks - the map of building decks per era

    • initGame

      public void initGame()

    • placeTotem

      public void placeTotem(String playerNickname, String selectedOfferTileId)
      The player's totem is placed on the selected offer tile.
      Parameters:
      playerNickname - the nickname of the player
      selectedOfferTileId - the id of the selected offer tile

    • resolveAction

      public ActionReceipt resolveAction(String playerNickname, List<String> chosenCharacterCardsIds, List<String> chosenBuildingCardsIds)
      The standard action phase is resolved for a player, processing card acquisitions, costs, passive effects, and totem repositioning.
      Parameters:
      playerNickname - the nickname of the player performing the action
      chosenCharacterCardsIds - the list of character card ids chosen by the player
      chosenBuildingCardsIds - the list of building card ids chosen by the player
      Returns:
      an action receipt containing the resulting statistics change and turn order position
      Throws:
      InvalidGameActionException - if the action is invalid or the player cannot afford it

    • forfeitAction

      public ActionReceipt forfeitAction(String playerNickname)
      The player's action is forfeited, moving their totem directly to the turn order tile without acquiring any cards.
      Parameters:
      playerNickname - the nickname of the player forfeiting the action
      Returns:
      an action receipt containing the resulting statistics change and turn order position

    • resolveExtraAcquisition

      public ExtraAcquisitionReceipt resolveExtraAcquisition(String playerNickname, String cardId)
      The extra acquisition phase is resolved, allowing a player to purchase an additional card from the upper row.
      Parameters:
      playerNickname - the nickname of the player performing the extra acquisition
      cardId - the id of the card to be acquired
      Returns:
      an extra acquisition receipt detailing the costs and bonuses of the acquisition

    • resolveEvents

      public List<EventResolutionReceipt> resolveEvents()
      Events in the lower tribe row are resolved sequentially and resolution receipts are returned.
      Returns:
      a list of receipts detailing the resolution of each event
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the current phase is not resolve_events
